preview.what: Enough TypeScript to read and write typed React/Next code confidently.
preview.picture: Types are the label on a jar. Generics are a jar whose label says 'contents: whatever you put in'. Narrowing is opening the lid to check before you use it.
preview.why: Next.js roles assume TypeScript; being unsure looks junior.
preview.bn: Type = জারের লেবেল, generic = 'যা রাখবে তাই', narrowing = খোলার আগে ঢাকনা দেখে নেওয়া।
